title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Retroactive-Exposure Load on Residential Placements
content:
**Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier, residential placement schedule.**

> Retroactive-exposure load for a new placement: the rated amount of a new placement is multiplied by 1.10 when more than 60 days run from the lapse date to the notice date on the loan's first notice, by 1.04 when 15 to 60 days run from the lapse date to that notice date, and by 1.00 when fewer than 15 days run from the lapse date to that notice date or the notice is dated on or before the lapse date.

Both dates are read from the first notice of the loan being placed: the lapse date it records (the date the borrower's coverage lapsed or became insufficient, as tracked) and its notice date. Days between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the later date, the earlier date excluded and the later date included.

| Days from the lapse date to the notice date | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Notice dated on or before the lapse date | 1.00 |
| 1 to 14 days | 1.00 |
| 15 to 60 days | 1.04 |
| 61 days or more | 1.10 |

## Hypothetical date pairs

| Lapse date | Notice date | Days counted | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 15 March | 14 | 1.00 |
| 1 March | 16 March | 15 | 1.04 |
| 1 March | 30 April | 60 | 1.04 |
| 1 March | 1 May | 61 | 1.10 |
| 10 June | 5 June | notice before lapse | 1.00 |

(The pairs use one non-leap year; dates are illustrative only.)
